label: The weighted-average maximum
subgoals: Weight each coordinate by its softmax weight
Divide the weighted sum by the sum of weights
Note that the estimate never exceeds the true maximum

label: The WA wirelength
subgoals: Subtract the weighted-average minimum from the weighted-average maximum
Compare the estimate with the exact span
Reuse the per-net exponential sums for the gradient

label: WA versus LSE in practice
subgoals: Contrast the overestimate of LSE with the underestimate of WA
Weigh WA's accuracy against its loss of convexity
Hide both behind one value-and-gradient interface
